examples: But you have only just got here.
words.trans: 刚刚、才（发生时间极短）。only 和 just 放一起不是重复，是英式口语固定搭配 only-just，用来强调：抵达这件事才刚刚发生，时间非常近（暗含：你都还没待一会儿，怎么就要走了）

examples: He got to the beach in time to see Stingray slash past a hire boat.
words.trans: v. 猛冲掠过；劈、划；飞快横扫而过

examples: Suddenly the longing for eyes in the sky was all-consuming.
words.trans: adj. 占据全部心神的，排山倒海般、挥之不去的（情绪）

examples: He called up Skylark, his eyes in the sky above the lake.
words.trans: 天空中的眼睛（指无人机/直升机等空中监视）

examples: He could anchor, call up Skylark and get to work.
words.trans: 调出，唤醒，启动程序/设备

examples: He waded out to unhitch the stern rope.
words.trans: v. 解开，松开（拴住的绳索）

examples: He waded out to unhitch the stern rope at the back of the boat.
words.trans: n. 船尾（stern rope 船尾那根缆绳）

examples: He yanked the cord again and again, but there was no sign of combustion.
words.trans: n. 燃烧

examples: He could see the driver walking up the woodchip path into the trees.
words.trans: 木屑铺就的小路

examples: He spat through clenched teeth as he yanked the cord.
words.trans: v. 猛拽，用力猛地一拉

examples: The propeller flicked round once the starter cord was pulled.
words.trans: n. 绳索；拉绳；这里特指小艇发动机的手拉启动绳

examples: He yanked the cord again and again, until his fingers stung.
words.trans: v.（sting 的过去式与过去分词 stung）刺痛；火辣辣地灼痛

examples: He knew the engine was dead, and that Snakey had messed things up after all.
words.trans: 短语，终究、到头来、果然（带感慨，结果和自己预想对上了）。与 sure enough 都译作果然但底层不同：sure enough 是亲眼看见事实印证之前的猜想（眼见为实，常放句首，偏客观）；after all 是兜兜转转经历波折后，最终结局落到原先的猜测（常放句尾，带感慨、挫败，多事后复盘明白真相）

examples: The hire boat bobbed on the remnant of Stingray's wash.
words.trans: n. 残余、余波

examples: It took a few seconds for the computer to lock on to his position.
words.trans: 锁定（目标）

examples: Skylark appeared, a speck of black high in the greying sky.
words.trans: 一小点……（a speck of black 天上远远小小的黑色小点，指 Skylark 无人机）

examples: The drone looked like a long-haul jet on its final descent from some distant land.
words.trans: 长途民航客机

examples: The drone hovered like a long-haul jet on its final descent.
words.trans: （长途客机）进入最后下降阶段

examples: The drone passed overhead, banked around and settled into an approach.
words.trans: 航空动词 bank：飞机压坡度转弯。banked around：机身倾斜，盘旋转弯

examples: The drone settled into a bumpy approach towards them.
words.trans: approach 航空术语：进近，降落的最后阶段。a bumpy approach 颠簸的进近降落，风比较大，无人机落地前晃来晃去

examples: Skylark, more like! Maggie crouched on the pebbles and watched him.
words.trans: 口语短语：倒不如说是；更像是；说成XX还差不多，带调侃、打趣、轻微反驳前面的说法

examples: Maggie crouched on the pebbles and watched him guardedly.
words.trans: adv. 心存戒备地，提防地

examples: At the southern end sat the grand round house, concealed from the lake by trees.
words.trans: v. 隐藏，遮蔽，掩盖

examples: The house was hidden by enormous Douglas firs and monkey puzzle trees.
words.trans: 智利南洋杉，外形非常奇特的大型针叶树

examples: The chopper was pacing about on the grass, smoking.
words.trans: 来回踱步

examples: The chopper sat smoking on the grass, with no one around.
words.trans: n. 口语 = helicopter，直升机

examples: A helicopter with no markings looked pretty dodgy to the boys.
words.trans: adj.【英/澳口语】可疑的，来路不正的，居心叵测的

examples: Stingray, little more than a shadow in the grey light, was hugging the shore.
words.trans: 固定句型：只不过是、仅仅是，几乎就只是，弱化程度。After sunset the boat was little more than a shadow 日落之后那条船就只剩下一道黑影

examples: Stingray was hugging the eastern shore of Benson Isle.
words.trans: hug（船只）紧贴海岸线航行，贴着岸边走

examples: They watched the boat nose on to a jetty, half-hidden by branches.
words.trans: nose 动词：船头缓缓顶靠上去。nose onto 缓缓驶靠码头

examples: Maggie jumped into Bobalong and began to put the oars into the rowlocks.
words.trans: n. 桨叉；桨座（小艇舷边U型卡扣，用来卡住船桨，作为支点划桨）

examples: She dug the blades into the water, sending up a spray.
words.trans: v. 本义挖掘；此处文学动词：猛扎、狠狠切入

examples: She dug the blades into the water, sending a curtain of water over his feet.
words.trans: n. 桨叶；船桨浸入水里的扁平叶片部分，复数 blades

examples: She dug the oars in, sending a curtain of water over his feet.
words.trans: 水幕。a curtain of water 像帘子一样一大片飞溅的水花

examples: Tom hoisted his good leg over and flopped on to the bench.
words.trans: v. 重重地摔坐；噗通一声瘫倒，没有优雅的动作，身体笨重地落下去

examples: Explain what? Maggie said, leaning back into a stroke.
words.trans: 划船时，身体向后仰，借着后仰发力完成这一划

examples: She frowned with the effort of each stroke.
words.trans: n. 划船的一划；一次划桨动作。划船完整一个来回就叫 one stroke

examples: The wind began to gust, emptying spinnakers like burst balloons.
words.trans: n. 大三角帆（帆船专用，颜色鲜艳，顺风的时候张开的巨大球形帆）

examples: A bank of clouds with charcoal-grey under-bellies was billowing in from the south.
words.trans: n. 底部；下腹；朝下的那一面（under 下方 + belly 腹部合成）。a bank of clouds with charcoal-grey under-bellies 一大片云层，云底是炭灰色

examples: Dark clouds were billowing in from the south.
words.trans: 滚滚翻腾涌过来（之前见过 billowing behind 滚滚向后翻腾）

examples: He looked at Maggie, her dark eyes fixed in front of her.
words.trans: 固定搭配：把目光定格在某处，目不转睛

examples: He could feel the cold seeping into the soles of his feet.
words.trans: v. 缓慢渗透、一点点钻进来

examples: You had better take over, Joel said, passing the tablet back.
words.trans: 接手操作

examples: Tom took Skylark higher and banked into a wide circuit of the island.
words.trans: bank 压坡度转弯；circuit 绕圈飞行。banked into a wide circuit of the island 无人机压坡度转弯，绕着岛屿大圈盘旋

examples: The overcast sky would mean the drone would be hard to spot from below.
words.trans: adj.（天空）阴沉沉的，乌云密布的

examples: He could not take any chances with the drone in the wind.
words.trans: 碰运气；冒险；铤而走险，去赌一把 ≈ take risks，但侧重心存侥幸、赌运气，指望运气帮自己过关，暗含未必做好万全准备

examples: Come on! Maggie said, looking over her shoulder.
words.trans: 回头向后张望

examples: Before he could stop her, she was out and running along the planks.
words.trans: n. 厚木板；（码头、栈桥上面铺的）木板平台

examples: If he could just get on his own somewhere quiet, he could think.
words.trans: 习语：独自一人，不受打扰；自己待着

words.word: have a hard time doing something
examples: They know the island is private and we would have a hard time getting Archie back.
words.trans: 做某事很费劲、处境艰难，要吃不少苦头

words.word: What does something have to do with
examples: What is all this got to do with Archie and Snakey? Maggie asked.
words.trans: = What’s all this got to do with…：这一大堆事情跟……又有什么关系？

examples: Grey lichen clung to the rough bark of the old rowan.
words.trans: n. 地衣；苔藓类植物。高空俯视，成片树顶远远看去，就像地面斑驳的地衣
